messages:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGER: Alert PD-98421 fired for inference-edge-usw2 — elevated HTTP 5xx rate detected (window: 2m)
incident-bot: Metric: 5xx_ratio = 8.6% (threshold 4%). Trigger: sustained error rate across >3 gateway pods.

alice_sre: i'm on it. acking and joining.
pd-bot: Alert acknowledged by alice_sre (oncall)

bob_platform: quick note — there was an infra scale event ~4m ago in usw2. could be churn. checking LB health and backend node churn.
carol_runtime: looking at upstream model-hosting logs. getting repeated "upstream read timeout" and a lot of short-lived connections.
carol_runtime: sample log:
```
2026-03-15T11:12:01Z model-hosting-27 nginx[2345]: [error] *112 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response, client: 10.24.1.9, request: "POST /v1/chat/completions"
```

dan_oncall: any single api-key or customer driving this?
alice_sre: initial traffic breakdown — top contributor is api-key: ingest-prod-12 (approx 60% of burst). not uniform across keys.

eve_custsuccess: i had a DM earlier — one customer reported elevated latencies, i'll ping them for exact SDK versions and retry behavior.

carol_runtime: kv-cache hit rate low on the gateway for these flows: 15%. if cache cold, model-hosting gets hammered with repeated prefix work.
carol_runtime: model-serving pod cpu shows long GC pauses on model-hosting-2.

bob_platform: quick mitigation options: 1) soft-edge rate-limit for the noisy key, 2) activate degraded-model variant (smaller quantized) behind a feature flag, 3) circuit-break repetitive 502 producers.

alice_sre: applying soft-edge RT control now for ingest-prod-12 to 20 rps to buy time. cmd: `rbctl policy apply --scope key:ingest-prod-12 --rate 20rps --reason "5xx surge"`
ops-bot: Edge policy applied by alice_sre. Expect increased 429s for that key until lifted.

carol_runtime: launching extra replicas of quantized-serving group to soak traffic. `kubectl scale deploy model-quant -n model --replicas=6`
carol_runtime: also enabling sticky keepalive tweak on LB -> backends to reduce connection churn.

bob_platform: i'm routing a small canary away from model-hosting-2 (suspect node). will monitor 5xx across the slice.

alice_sre: enabling route-level circuit-breaker for backend cluster to avoid cascade. config snippet: 
```
route: model-hosting
  cb:
    consecutive_5xx: 4
    cooldown: 45s
```

pd-bot: Escalation policy: oncall -> eng-runtime pager -> eng-platform if unacked >5m

carol_runtime: cache warm-up observed after throttling and adding quantized pods — gateway kv_hit ~52% after 6m. 5xx ratio trending down to 2.7%.
dan_oncall: still seeing sporadic 502s tied to model-hosting-2; node shows OOM events earlier. collecting heap dumps and dmesg.

eve_custsuccess: update — customer confirms they had aggressive client retries (lower backoff) during SDK version 1.4.2; looks correlated. they will patch to backoff client and report.

bob_platform: suggestion for medium-term: tune autoscaler cooldown and increase LB keepalive from 30s -> 90s for backend pool. also consider default client-side jitter guidance in docs.

alice_sre: turning incident into a short-lived mitigation: - edge throttle for noisy key, - circuit-breaker active, - canary reroute off node, - scale quantized variant. keeping incident open for RCA and 1hr check-ins.

ops-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-2026-98421 created, owner: alice_sre

alice_sre: current status: 5xx ratio 0.9% (below threshold). I'm handing monitoring to next oncall for 60m. will open a Confluence timeline + assign RCA to eng-runtime.

pd-bot: Alert resolved by alice_sre at 1769814000

alice_sre: post-incident TODOs in thread: collect GC/heap logs for model-hosting-2; verify autoscaler scaling windows; add default client retry guidance; consider increasing LB keepalive; instrument early kv-cache misses as an SLI.

alice_sre: thanks everyone — nice coordination. :heart:
